title: The Last Taxi: LCR Buffers and Bank Liquidity Provision
title_zh: 最后的出租车：流动性覆盖率缓冲与银行流动性供给
authors: R. Matthew Darst, Lucia Gurrieri, Arazi Lubis, Alexandros P. Vardoulakis
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines whether regulatory liquidity buffers enable banks to support corporate borrowers during financial stress. Using confidential bank-firm credit data and handcollected Liquidity Coverage Ratio regulation (LCR) disclosures during COVID-19, we find that banks with higher LCR buffers above the regulatory minimum provided significantly more credit to firms with large undrawn credit lines in March 2020. Critically, only buffers, not overall LCR levels, matter, revealing that the regulatory minimum operates as a binding constraint during stress. The effect is concentrated among high-quality borrowers with clean credit profiles and disappears by mid-2020, confirming that LCR buffers provide selective, temporary liquidity insurance during acute stress.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了监管流动性缓冲是否能使银行在金融压力时期为企业借款人提供支持。利用新冠疫情期间的机密银行-企业信贷数据及手工收集的流动性覆盖率（LCR）监管披露信息，我们发现，在2020年3月，LCR缓冲高于监管最低要求的银行，向拥有大量未提取信贷额度的企业提供了显著更多的信贷。关键在于，只有缓冲水平而非整体LCR水平产生影响，这表明监管最低要求在压力时期构成了具有约束力的限制。这一效应集中于信用记录良好的高质量借款人，并在2020年年中消失，证实了LCR缓冲在严重压力时期提供了选择性、临时性的流动性保险。

title: Taxing Top Incomes in the Emerging World—Fiscal and Economic Impact under the Microscope
title_zh: 新兴世界中的高收入征税——财政与经济影响的微观审视
authors: Axelson, Christopher, Hohmann, Antonia, Pirttilä, Jukka, Raabe, Roxanne, Riedel, Nadine
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper studies taxpayer responses to an increase in the top marginal tax rate in South Africa, drawing on rich administrative data and a transparent identification strategy. We show that treated taxpayers strongly reduced their reported taxable income in response to the reform, with adjustments along a broad range of taxable income components. While tax evasion and avoidance explain a sizable share of this response, there is also indication for reduced work effort and business performance of South African corporations led by treated taxpayers—suggesting that raising taxes on top incomes may entail broader economic repercussions.
abstract_zh: 本文利用丰富的行政数据和透明的识别策略，研究了南非最高边际税率上调后纳税人的反应。我们发现，受影响的纳税人显著减少了其申报的应税收入，调整涉及应税收入的多个组成部分。尽管逃税和避税行为在很大程度上解释了这一反应，但也有迹象表明，受影响的纳税人所领导的南非企业的工作努力程度和经营业绩有所下降——这表明对高收入群体增税可能带来更广泛的经济影响。

title: Unintended effects of gender quotas on task assignment and firm performance
title_zh: 性别配额对任务分配和企业绩效的非预期影响
abstract: We examine the unintended effects of gender‐based hiring quotas on task allocation and organizational performance using a controlled laboratory experiment designed to mirror team formation and delegation decisions. Participants in the role of employers selected workers and assigned them to either simple or challenging tasks, where performance determined firm earnings. In the absence of quotas, high‐ability women were less likely than their male counterparts to be hired or assigned to high‐responsibility tasks. Imposing a 50% gender quota increased overall female representation and their access to complex tasks, but did not improve outcomes for high‐performing women, who remain relatively less likely to be assigned to high‐responsibility tasks compared to comparable men. Moreover, firm performance declined under the quota due to weaker alignment between worker ability and task assignment. These findings suggest that while quotas enhance representational equity, they may unintentionally reduce efficiency when organizational processes fail to support merit‐based allocation—offering important implications for the design of equity‐enhancing labour market policies.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项受控实验室实验，研究了基于性别的招聘配额对任务分配和组织绩效的非预期影响。该实验旨在模拟团队组建和授权决策。扮演雇主的参与者选择工人，并将其分配到简单或具有挑战性的任务中，任务表现决定企业收益。在没有配额的情况下，高能力女性被雇佣或分配到高责任任务的可能性低于同等能力的男性。实施50%的性别配额提高了女性的整体代表性及其接触复杂任务的机会，但并未改善高绩效女性的结果——与同等能力的男性相比，她们被分配到高责任任务的可能性仍然相对较低。此外，由于工人能力与任务分配之间的匹配度减弱，配额下的企业绩效出现下降。这些发现表明，虽然配额增强了代表性公平，但当组织流程未能支持基于能力的分配时，它们可能无意中降低效率——这对设计促进公平的劳动力市场政策具有重要启示。

title: Ned Phelps and modern macroeconomics
title_zh: 内德·菲尔普斯与现代宏观经济学
official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The macroeconomic theory that is taught in graduate schools, and used in the conduct of monetary and fiscal policy around the world today, emerged from a revolution in economics that was led by Ned Phelps. This column discusses Phelps’s theoretical contributions and how they created a micro foundation for macroeconomics.
abstract_zh: 如今研究生院教授并被全球用于货币与财政政策制定的宏观经济理论，源于由内德·菲尔普斯引领的经济学革命。本文探讨了菲尔普斯的理论贡献，以及这些贡献如何为宏观经济学奠定了微观基础。

title: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
title_zh: 从参保决策衡量伤残保险的价值
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于：既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出一种新颖的显示性偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。研究表明，通过比较DI参保率对福利变化与工资变化的反应差异，即可识别其保险价值。在加拿大应用该框架后，我们估算出：每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但能创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。

title: Tax Evasion and the Contribution-Benefit Link: The Case of Parental Benefits in Hungary and Latvia
title_zh: 逃税与缴费-受益关联：匈牙利和拉脱维亚育儿福利案例研究
authors: Bíró, Anikó, Elek, Péter, Jascisens, Vitalijs, Prinz, Dániel, Sándor, László, Zasova, Anna
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the interaction of the contribution-benefit link with tax evasion in the context of parental benefits in Hungary and Latvia. Across the two countries, institutional settings, and time periods, earnings and employment patterns suggest substantial pre-pregnancy underreporting, followed by partial formalization during pregnancy to increase benefits. Using policy reforms, the paper shows that the reporting response tracks changing incentives. The results indicate that even with third-party reporting, income underreporting can be common. Linking benefits to contributions when earnings are underreported may reduce evasion temporarily but can impose net fiscal costs depending on program design.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了匈牙利和拉脱维亚育儿福利背景下，缴费-福利关联与逃税行为的相互作用。在两国的制度环境与时间跨度中，收入与就业模式显示，孕前存在大量低报收入现象，而孕期则出现部分正规化以增加福利。通过政策改革分析，本文证明申报行为随激励变化而调整。结果表明，即便存在第三方报告机制，收入低报仍可能普遍存在。当收入被低报时，将福利与缴费挂钩虽能暂时减少逃税，但根据项目设计不同，可能产生净财政成本。

title: Input Sourcing under Climate Risk: Evidence from U.S. Manufacturing Firms
title_zh: 气候风险下的投入品采购：来自美国制造业企业的证据
authors: Joaquin Blaum, Federico Esposito, Sebastian Heise
abstract: We study the effect of risk on how firms organize their supply chains. We use transaction-level data on U.S. manufacturing imports to construct a novel measure of input sourcing risk based on the historical volatility of ocean shipping times. Our measure isolates the unexpected component of shipping times that is induced by weather conditions along more than 331,000 maritime routes. We first document that unexpected shipping delays significantly reduce importers’ sales, profits, and employment. We then show that firms actively diversify weather risk by using more routes and foreign suppliers, although their import values decline. To rationalize these findings, we introduce shipping time risk into a general equilibrium model of importing with firm heterogeneity. Our quantitative analysis predicts substantial costs for the U.S. economy associated with supply chain risk.
